description: Full details of one promotion by its id (from a search result): dates, conditions, outlets, source link, and links to add it to a calendar or save it with a start reminder. Pass lat/lng to sort outlets nearest first and get nearest_outlet.

id.description: The deal's id, from a search or list result.

lat.description: Optional: where the person is, to find the nearest outlet.

lng.description: Optional: longitude, used together with lat.

name: get_promotion
title: Get one deal
